integrity: The full integral vertical-divisor quotient is reconstructed from the twelve blow-ups and verified by exact determinantal-divisor calculations. Rank alone is not used to infer torsion. The proof relies on the initiating paper for the resolved fiber configuration and independently computes the Smith invariants.
scientific_limitations: The exact group is proved only for the explicit Sun–Xu characteristic-5 reduction. No assertion is made for the characteristic-zero pencil, other reductions, or deformations. The 1995 sources tied to the original pencil were not fully accessible in the checked public routes and remain a stated literature risk.
title: The four-fiber Jacobian has Mordell–Weil group \(\mathbf Z/12\mathbf Z\)
